dogecoin.text: Wow #dogecoin just blew past 10 cents. WOW!!!

I laugh at these “veteran traders” on yahoo finance who said that #dogecoin is going to cease to exist. 

Doge has been around since 2013. It’s older than ETH and it’s still here.

If this doesn’t legitimize #dogecoin somewhat. I’m not sure what will! 

This is huge for all investors!! @Newegg is one of the biggest electronics marketplaces around. 

Happy #DogeDay everyone!!!

Just heard that Jeff Bezos is shortly going to become a huge #dogecoin investor. 

Do you know what the implication of a coin that the 2 richest people on the planet will do!! 

Not to mention if @amazon begins to accept it as a form of payment.

Forget the moon... hello Saturn!
